new_result.statement: For any determinant-weighted physical 3-minor packet of total mass P, if row/column support sets R0,C0 have determinant-inclusion tail sums delta_R,delta_C with theta=1-delta_R-delta_C>0, then Z3(A[R0,C0])>=theta P and s3(A[R0,C0])>=sqrt(theta P)/(sqrt(C(r,3))||A[R0,C0]||op^2). The symmetric principal core A[R0 union C0] therefore has three actual eigenvalues at that scale. In N3(tau), ||p_Q||inf<=2 sqrt(6 pi d) sqrt(C(r,3)) p q (tau+tau^2)/sqrt(theta P).
new_result.scope: all bounded determinant-marginal-support branches of the partner colored third-compound packets; no individual minor selection
new_result.partner_application: For active q2 with P2>=1/512, p=q=4, theta>=1/2, tau=1/128 gives ||p_Q||inf<198.014.

construction.statement: For even N, M_N=[[0,u^T],[v,xy^T]] with u=v=constant unit vector and x=y=alternating-sign unit vector has singular values 1,1,1; A_N=[[0,M_N],[M_N^T,0]] has spectrum +/-1 three times. All nonzero third minors contain fixed row/column anchors, total anchored mass is 1, each residual inclusion marginal is 2/N, and every fixed-size principal core has operator norm O(N^-1/2). For N>128 the family is in N3(1/128).
construction.scope: refutes only bounded-cardinality core extraction from constant bi-anchor mass; not QFORM
construction.payment: e5 Theorem MF with two heavy anchors and rank-two light block gives ||p_Q||inf<=3*2^(1/3)<3.780
